clue.text: Trips some time after exam result

indicators.note: the time piece is placed after the exam result in the answer

parts.note: a pass is a successful result in an exam
ages means a long time

explanation.surface: Someone recalls journeys made a while after getting their exam results.
explanation.definitionFit: Passages are journeys, especially by sea, so they are trips.

clue.text: Flier runs over in a bit

indicators.note: the runs and over go inside the bit

parts.note: a part is a bit
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: A cricket scorer noting runs within an over, with a flying ball.
explanation.definitionFit: A parrot is a bird, and a bird is a flier.

clue.text: Run after Romney, resolved to be formal

parts.note: to stand for office is to run in an election
once can mean as soon as or after, as in once you are done

indicators.note: resolved means broken down and reformed, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A US politician campaigns after Mitt Romney, determined to be proper.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand on ceremony is an idiom for insisting on formal behaviour.

clue.text: Key scripture backing change

parts.note: Alt is a key on a computer keyboard

indicators.note: in a down clue, backing means the letters are read upwards

parts.note: RE is religious education, i.e. scripture lessons

explanation.surface: An important scripture supporting reform.
explanation.definitionFit: To alter is to modify, a straightforward synonym of change.

clue.text: Artwork quite attractive once topped

indicators.note: once the top letter is cut off, the attractive word loses its first letter

parts.note: fetching means attractive

explanation.surface: A picture that looks rather nice after being framed at the top.
explanation.definitionFit: An etching is a print made from an engraved plate, an artwork.

clue.text: Note unserious escape

parts.note: F is a musical note
light means not serious, as in light reading

explanation.surface: A short message about a frivolous getaway.
explanation.definitionFit: Flight is the act of fleeing, so it is an escape.

clue.text: Oil club I rate poorly

indicators.note: poorly suggests the letters are in bad shape, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rich investor gives a low rating to a club.
explanation.definitionFit: To oil machinery is to grease it, making it run smoothly.

clue.text: Showgirl left out mistakenly as shooting starts

indicators.note: done in error, so the letters are put in a wrong order

explanation.surface: A dancer is wrongly omitted as filming begins.
explanation.walkthrough: The Glorious Twelfth is 12 August, when the British grouse-shooting season opens; 'shooting' suggests a film set.
explanation.definitionFit: The date named marks the opening of the grouse season, the time when shooting starts.

clue.text: People with energy stop Soviet news agency being bland

indicators.note: the people and energy stop up, i.e. plug, the news agency

parts.note: TASS was the Soviet news agency
men are people
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Energetic people shutting down the Soviet press for being dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Tameness is a lack of excitement, the state of blandness.

clue.text: Put back on stretch of river keeping one dry

indicators.note: the stretch of river holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: a reach is a straight stretch of a river
A means one, as in a single thing
TT is teetotal, i.e. dry

explanation.surface: Someone restores something along a river section while keeping one teetotal person aboard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dry' is a common crossword signal for teetotal, written TT; 'keeping' means the river stretch holds the other letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To reattach something is to fasten it again, putting it back on.

clue.text: Sailor to threaten bursting out

parts.note: AB is an able seaman
to loom is to appear threateningly

explanation.surface: A sailor menaces someone into breaking out.
explanation.definitionFit: Flowers that are bursting out are in bloom, a synonym for that state of blossoming.

clue.text: Delayed standing up with the others

indicators.note: in a down clue, standing up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: late means delayed

explanation.surface: Someone running late stood up together with the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin abbreviation means and others, as in a list of authors.

clue.text: Senior operatives Liberal Democrats employ revolt leaders

indicators.note: the leading letters of the five words after Senior are taken

explanation.surface: Political veterans in the Liberal Democrats hire staff who lead an uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone senior is of greater age or rank, a comparative synonym.

clue.text: Travel company into changing following popular feeling

indicators.note: the travel company and the rearranged word come after the popular piece

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
TUI is a large holiday and travel company

indicators.note: the word into is rearranged

explanation.surface: A tour operator switching to a trendy approach.
explanation.definitionFit: Intuition is an instinctive sense or hunch, a feeling about something.

clue.text: Central Council apologies will remove impediment

indicators.note: the central three letters of each of the two words that follow are taken

explanation.surface: A central council's apology will clear an obstacle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Central' takes the middle three letters of each word: UNC from Council and LOG from apologies.
explanation.definitionFit: To unclog a pipe is to clear a blockage, removing an impediment.

clue.text: A rifle dug up by safety worker

indicators.note: dug up suggests disturbance, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A gun excavated by a beach attendant.
explanation.definitionFit: A lifeguard keeps swimmers safe, so is a safety worker.

clue.text: Fit into the French competitions

indicators.note: the fit goes inside the French article

parts.note: les is French for the (plural)
an ague is a fit of shivering fever

explanation.surface: Something slots into the French sporting tournaments.
explanation.definitionFit: Leagues are organised competitions between teams, as in football.

clue.text: Got higher position when Charlie died

parts.note: as can mean when, as in as he left
C is Charlie in the NATO alphabet
ended means died, came to an end

explanation.surface: Charlie's promotion came when someone died.
explanation.definitionFit: To ascend is to climb, so ascended means rose or went up.

clue.text: Considers it appropriate to look at odd man out that's dropped note

parts.note: to see is to look at

indicators.note: the misfit loses the note from its letters

parts.note: a misfit is an odd man out
mi is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Someone judges it right to view a loner who has abandoned a musical note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's dropped' removes MI from MISFIT, leaving SFIT.
explanation.definitionFit: To see fit is an idiom meaning to judge something suitable.

clue.text: River Thames's source is in Dijon

indicators.note: a river's source is where it begins, so the first letter is taken

parts.note: est is French for is, and Dijon is in France

explanation.surface: The source of the Thames is claimed to be in a French city.
explanation.walkthrough: The Test is a river in Hampshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: The Test is an English chalk stream famous for trout fishing.

clue.text: Sets of books on time factors

indicators.note: the books piece comes on, i.e. after, the time piece

parts.note: an age is a period of time
NT is the New Testament, a set of books; NTS is the plural

explanation.surface: Collections of books arranged according to era and other variables.
explanation.definitionFit: A factor is an agent acting on another's behalf, so the plural matches.

clue.text: Town with some balls

parts.note: and means with, together with
in cricket an over is a set of six balls

explanation.surface: A town that owns a few balls.
explanation.walkthrough: Andover is a town in Hampshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Andover is a market town in Hampshire in southern England.

clue.text: Australian doctor was first, having walked slowly

parts.note: MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's qualification
led means was in front, was first

explanation.surface: An Australian GP led the way after a slow walk.
explanation.definitionFit: To amble is to stroll at a leisurely pace.

clue.text: Excited Greens die out

indicators.note: out means wrong or disordered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Environmentalists dying away, oddly stirred up.
explanation.definitionFit: Energised means filled with energy, stirred up or excited.

clue.text: Polish sign about pasture being genetically-modified

indicators.note: the modified letters go round the pasture

parts.note: GM stands for genetically modified
a lea is grassland or pasture

explanation.surface: A shiny mark on a field of GM crops.
explanation.definitionFit: A gleam is a flash of shine, the visible mark of a good polish.

clue.text: German put up excellent sail

indicators.note: in a down clue, put up means the letters are read upwards

parts.note: A1, said as A one, means excellent

explanation.surface: A German hoisted a superb sail.
explanation.definitionFit: A genoa is a large jib, a type of sail on a yacht.

clue.text: Called back using wireless I left in tree

indicators.note: the letters are read in reverse
the letter I leaves, i.e. is removed

parts.note: called using wireless is radioed

explanation.surface: A message about a radio call and a person left up a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Called ... using wireless' is RADIOED; 'I left' removes I, giving RADOED, and 'back' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: The deodar is a Himalayan cedar tree.

clue.text: Exciting to sound off about fuel crisis? Contrariwise

indicators.note: one piece goes around the other
the order is the opposite of what is stated, so the jumbled fuel goes round the venting
a crisis throws the word fuel into disorder

parts.note: to vent is to sound off or rant

explanation.surface: Someone ranting about a fuel shortage is thrilling, or the other way round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crisis' scrambles the fuel to EFUL. Read literally, 'about' would put the ranting round the fuel; 'Contrariwise' says the opposite holds.
explanation.definitionFit: An eventful time is full of happenings, so it is exciting.

clue.text: Boring promotions for woodlanders

parts.note: dry means dull or boring
ads are advertisements, promotions

explanation.surface: Dull adverts aimed at forest dwellers.
explanation.definitionFit: Dryads are tree nymphs of Greek myth, spirits living in woods.

clue.text: Mentioned insect found in bed

indicators.note: the insect is located inside the bed

parts.note: a roach is a cockroach

explanation.surface: Someone raised the subject of a bug discovered in their bed.
explanation.definitionFit: To broach a subject is to raise it, so broached means brought up.
